notes.title: Dorsaka July Update
notes.content: [p]July 2025 Update![/p][p][/p][p]If you're watching twitter/x then you'll already know I delayed this update - normally these take place on the 15th of each month.  I was travelling and so if anything didn't go according to plan or if I needed to make a quick change or update, I couldn't easily do it!  [/p][p]I'm going back to 15th for August as I have no more travel plans....at least not for now as I'm going to start a huge push to complete a game in the next few months.....more to come on that.....but for now.....heres the quick Dorsaka patch notes![/p][p][/p][p]Dorsaka Patch Notes[/p][p]Version 1.3 -  26 July 2025[/p][p]Items and Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Brazilian Portuguese Language added[/p][/*][*][p]Added key hints to language select screen update[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dorsaka May Update
notes.content:
[b]Dorsaka Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Version 1.1 -  15 May 2025[/b]

[u]Items and Fixes[/u]
- Added version number to title screen
- Edited walking sound effect (reduced/removed clipping effect)
- Sacred Herb
  - Fixed issue with sacred herb not working as intended
  - Changed Sound effect played when collecting herb
  - visual cue added to HUD when "under the influence"
- Added placeholder code for language translations

[u]Known Bugs[/u]
- Mac version limitation
  - Doesnt work on modern 64-bit systems (32-bit only)
    Possible gatekeeper/build issue.

[u]Other Business[/u]
- Japanese language translation delayed, our translator has disappeared.
  (they did say something about an ultra-magnetic reactor or something!)
- Nothing else, really.  Just working on stuff!  Hope everything is good with you!
